name: Multi Display Adjustment
description:
Brightness and contrast sliders for external displays, through DDC/CI. Every display gets its own sliders, under the name that Settings shows, either in a Displays tile in Quick Settings or, on GNOME 50, next to the brightness slider of GNOME. All external displays can also be adjusted together.
Requires ddcutil-service, which is quick to install, see https://github.com/samuelcecilio/multi-display-adjustment#installation-of-ddcutil-service. It keeps the sliders more responsive than calling ddcutil.
A fork of Display Adjustment by Maciej Wójcik (https://gitlab.com/w8jcik/display-adjustment).
